title: Unmute ALSA sound channels
summary: ALSA often starts with all channels muted. Use amixer or alsamixer to unmute Master, Speaker, and Headphone channels to get sound.

steps.explain: Unmute the Master channel using amixer.
Unmute the Speaker channel using amixer.
Unmute the Headphone channel using amixer.
Alternatively, use the interactive alsamixer interface. Navigate to Master and PCM channels and press 'm' to unmute them. Use arrow keys to adjust volume.
steps.gui: Use Left/Right arrows to select channel, 'm' to toggle mute, Up/Down to change volume.

steps.explain: Test if sound is working by playing a test tone through 2 channels.
